subject.title: Feature: Add costCurrency config option to customize cost display currency

question: Should OpenClaw add non-USD currency semantics for local model-cost estimates, and if so should the currency live per model, per provider, globally, or only as a display preference?
rationale: The request changes public config and accounting/display semantics across status, persisted session state, Usage UI aggregation, docs, and USD-named telemetry, so code review cannot safely choose the product contract.

options.title: Define the currency contract first
options.body: Choose ISO/unit semantics, scope, and mixed-currency aggregation behavior before implementation so all cost surfaces remain consistent.

options.title: Keep local estimates USD-only
options.body: Leave `models.providers.*.models[].cost` as a USD-only contract and rely on provider-billing `unit` data for non-USD balances and actual spend where available.

options.title: Add display-only currency symbols
options.body: Implement a narrow formatter preference while explicitly keeping stored values and telemetry as USD-like estimates, accepting mixed-currency ambiguity.

recommendation.title: Define the currency contract first
recommendation.body: Choose ISO/unit semantics, scope, and mixed-currency aggregation behavior before implementation so all cost surfaces remain consistent.

likelyOwner.reason: The adjacent cost-reporting, provider-billing, and current formatter history routes the cross-surface product decision most strongly to this owner.
